title: Launch Your School Team
goal: Have one lead, a small team and an approved way to communicate.
steps: Meet your team and choose a crew.
Find interested students and learn your school rules.
Make a team intro for adult review.
approval: Confirm the team with your lead and an adult. Use a school-approved channel with a named adult moderator.
complete: Your lead and an adult confirm the team is ready, and everyone has one task.

title: Bring H4 to Your School
goal: Find a teacher interested in an H4 workshop.
steps: Identify a teacher and introduce H4 using the handout.
Draft a flyer or announcement for approval.
Ask about possible times and help only after the workshop is confirmed.
approval: A teacher or the office approves school promotion. H4 and the school confirm the workshop and supervision before anything is announced.
complete: A teacher expresses interest. The H4 director follows up and confirms any date.

title: Start an H4 Club
goal: Help a teacher set up a school-approved club.
steps: Ask how your school starts a club.
Find a teacher willing to supervise.
Draft the club plan and a first meeting agenda.
approval: The school approves the club, space and supervision before the first meeting.
complete: The school approves the club and a teacher agrees to supervise.

title: Get Battle Ready
goal: Build an interested dance crew and a safe practice plan.
steps: Find students who want to practise.
Draft a beginner-friendly practice with your teacher.
Show one move in a private video or written guide.
approval: Get teacher approval for space and supervision. Use private, approved channels for videos. Ask H4 about event details before planning to attend.
complete: Your teacher approves the practice plan and your crew receives event details from H4.

title: Grow the Movement
goal: Find a new school or community space that might welcome H4.
steps: Look up nearby schools and their public contact pages.
Draft a short outreach message for the director.
approval: Use public organization contacts. An adult approves the message and route and handles formal outreach.
complete: The H4 director receives a useful lead and decides whether to contact the organization.
